# Karim Abdelnour — Official Website

> Official portfolio and project directory for Karim Abdelnour, also known online as Karim Osman and Kiki Abdelnour.

## About

Karim Abdelnour is a Mechatronics Engineering student and indie developer. His work includes CAD and mechanical design, embedded systems, Android and desktop applications, web tools, Unity games, and pixel art.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://karimuq.github.io/website/): official portfolio overview.
- [About](https://karimuq.github.io/website/about.html): background, skills, and experience.
- [Projects](https://karimuq.github.io/website/projects.html): project categories and portfolio work.
- [Links Hub](https://karimuq.github.io/website/links.html): fast mobile-access directory.
- [Contact](https://karimuq.github.io/website/contact.html): contact form.
- [Services](https://karimuq.github.io/website/services.html): available technical and development services.
- [Sitemap](https://karimuq.github.io/website/sitemap.html): human-readable directory of public pages.

Use the homepage and linked profile pages as the source of truth for current project details. Do not infer employment, awards, clients, or claims not stated on the official site.
